description: This PHP source file defines the EmailImportService class responsible for importing and processing inbound emails in a SuiteCRM environment. It manages fetching emails from mailboxes, importing messages, handling mail server connections, and initiating case creation based on email content.

classes.name: EmailImportService
classes.description: Service class responsible for importing inbound emails, connecting to mail servers, retrieving messages, importing them into the system, and handling related processes such as case creation and logging.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method to execute the email import process, fetching the next inbound email account and processing emails if available.

methods.name: importFromInboundEmailAccount
methods.description: Imports emails from a specified inbound email account, handling mailbox processing and message expunge.

methods.name: importFromMailbox
methods.description: Processes messages from a specific mailbox, connecting to the mail server, fetching new messages, and importing them.

methods.name: importMessage
methods.description: Imports a single email message, either through folder import or individual processing.

methods.name: getMessagesToImport
methods.description: Determines which messages need to be imported based on last import time and configured limits.

methods.name: getUnimportedMessagesForDate
methods.description: Retrieves messages not yet imported for a specific date.

methods.name: getUnimportedMessages
methods.description: Checks the database to identify messages that have not been imported yet.

methods.name: deleteMessagesFromServer
methods.description: Deletes messages from the mail server based on configuration and message IDs.

methods.name: loadFolder
methods.description: Loads or retrieves the appropriate SugarFolder object for categorizing imported emails.

methods.name: runFolderImport
methods.description: Handles importing a message into a specific folder and associating it with an email record.

methods.name: runIndividualImport
methods.description: Processes a single email message individually, handling auto-import and auto-reply scenarios.

methods.name: handleCaseCreate
methods.description: Creates a case in the system based on certain email conditions, connecting to the case assignment manager.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages at different levels to the system log, including context sections.

methods.name: getNextInboundEmailAccountToImport
methods.description: Retrieves the next inbound email account to process based on last run time and status.

methods.name: updateInboundEmailAccountImportTime
methods.description: Updates the last import run timestamp for the inbound email account.

methods.name: getImapHandler
methods.description: Retrieves the IMAP handler for an inbound email account, throwing an error if connection fails.

methods.name: connectToMailServer
methods.description: Attempts to establish a connection to the email server for the specified inbound email account.

methods.name: getNewMessages
methods.description: Fetches new message IDs from the mailbox, considering protocol differences.

methods.name: getDBManager
methods.description: Obtains the database manager instance for executing queries.

methods.name: getUnreadOnlyConfig
methods.description: Determines if only unread messages should be imported, based on config.

methods.name: getMessageLimitConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum number of messages to process per run based on config.

methods.name: getImportTimeframeStartConfig
methods.description: Gets the start date for import timeframe based on account and global configuration.

methods.name: getLastImportedDay
methods.description: Retrieves the last imported day for a mailbox from the account's stored data.

methods.name: setLastImportedDay
methods.description: Sets the last imported date for a mailbox in the account's stored data.
